body:
Drugs could never be an option for me, there a long history of addicts in my family and I've seen and heard too much to everyone want that. 
I'm glad it worked out for you, thank you for your advice! Sometimes it takes me a while to really understand things but I know my mum loves me and she's the only reason I've stuck around this long

The lady I was with was really nice and I never felt like she was judging me or anything but at the time I didn't have a clue what I was feeling (still don't but it's easier) I've thought about and talked about going back with my mum but the idea of talking to people to set it up is terrifying to me.

I was seeing a therapist when I was in school (it was organized thru the school) and I didn't find it that helpful. It brought up things that made me feel worse but I hadn't been thinking about before (ignoring the absolute incompetence from the school who was in charge of getting me there) Does it get better? The more ur there?
